sources.pcgamesn_map: Real-world Miami landmarks identified in trailers.
sources.miaminewtimes: South Florida references catalogued by local press.

en.title: Vice City
en.summary: The neon-soaked heart of Leonida and the game's main city, returning in a modern form. Rockstar's tagline calls it the darkest side of the sunniest place in America.
en.body:
Vice City returns as the centrepiece of Grand Theft Auto VI, reimagined for the present day. Rockstar's official site frames the setting as 'Vice City, USA' and describes it as the darkest side of the sunniest place in America.

Trailers show dense high-rise districts, beachfront strips, nightlife, social-media culture and causeways linking the mainland to the beach. Press and local outlets have matched many shots to real Miami locations, which is why Leonida Atlas lists Miami as a strongly evidenced, not official, real-world analogue.

Vice City is home to much of the supporting cast, including Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest and Real Dimez.

highlights: Causeways linking the mainland and Vice Beach
fields.analogue_note: Miami comparison is based on trailer shots matched to real locations; Rockstar has not published an official comparison.

tr.title: Vice City
tr.summary: Leonida'nın neon ışıklı kalbi ve oyunun ana şehri, modern haliyle geri dönüyor. Rockstar onu Amerika'nın en güneşli yerinin en karanlık yüzü olarak tanımlıyor.
tr.body:
Vice City, günümüze uyarlanmış haliyle Grand Theft Auto VI'nın merkezinde yer alıyor. Rockstar'ın resmi sitesi mekânı 'Vice City, USA' olarak sunuyor ve Amerika'nın en güneşli yerinin en karanlık yüzü diye tanımlıyor.

Fragmanlarda yoğun gökdelen bölgeleri, sahil şeritleri, gece hayatı, sosyal medya kültürü ve anakarayı sahile bağlayan köprü yolları görülüyor. Basın ve yerel yayınlar birçok sahneyi gerçek Miami konumlarıyla eşleştirdi; bu yüzden Leonida Atlas, Miami'yi resmi değil ama güçlü kanıta dayanan gerçek dünya karşılığı olarak listeliyor.

Vice City, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest ve Real Dimez dahil yardımcı karakterlerin çoğuna ev sahipliği yapıyor.

highlights: Anakarayı Vice Beach'e bağlayan köprü yolları
fields.analogue_note: Miami karşılaştırması gerçek konumlarla eşleştirilen fragman sahnelerine dayanıyor; Rockstar resmi bir karşılaştırma yayımlamadı.

es.title: Vice City
es.summary: El corazón de neón de Leonida y la ciudad principal del juego, de vuelta en versión moderna. Rockstar la define como el lado más oscuro del lugar más soleado de Estados Unidos.
es.body:
Vice City vuelve como pieza central de Grand Theft Auto VI, reinventada para la actualidad. La web oficial de Rockstar presenta el escenario como 'Vice City, USA' y lo describe como el lado más oscuro del lugar más soleado de Estados Unidos.

Los tráileres muestran distritos de rascacielos, paseos marítimos, vida nocturna, cultura de redes sociales y calzadas que unen el continente con la playa. La prensa ha relacionado muchos planos con lugares reales de Miami; por eso Leonida Atlas indica Miami como equivalente real con pruebas sólidas, no oficial.

Vice City es el hogar de buena parte del reparto secundario, como Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest y Real Dimez.

highlights: Distritos de playa y vida nocturna
Calzadas entre el continente y Vice Beach
fields.analogue_note: La comparación con Miami se basa en planos de los tráileres asociados a lugares reales; Rockstar no ha publicado una comparación oficial.

zh-CN.title: 罪恶都市
zh-CN.summary: 莱奥尼达州霓虹闪烁的心脏，也是游戏的主要城市，以现代面貌回归。Rockstar 称其为“美国最阳光之地的最黑暗一面”。
zh-CN.body:
罪恶都市以当代面貌回归，成为《侠盗猎车手 VI》的核心舞台。Rockstar 官方网站将其称为“美国罪恶都市”，并形容它是美国最阳光之地的最黑暗一面。

预告片展示了密集的高楼区、海滨大道、夜生活、社交媒体文化，以及连接大陆与海滩的堤道。媒体已将许多镜头与迈阿密的真实地点对应，因此 Leonida Atlas 将迈阿密列为“证据充分”而非“官方”的现实原型。

罪恶都市是许多配角的家，包括布比·艾克、德雷宽·普里斯特和 Real Dimez。

highlights: 连接大陆与罪恶海滩的堤道
fields.analogue_note: 迈阿密的对比基于预告片镜头与真实地点的对应；Rockstar 并未发布官方对比。

it.title: Vice City
it.summary: Il cuore al neon della Leonida e città principale del gioco, di ritorno in versione moderna. Rockstar la definisce il lato più oscuro del posto più soleggiato d'America.
it.body:
Vice City torna come fulcro di Grand Theft Auto VI, reinventata per i giorni nostri. Il sito ufficiale di Rockstar presenta l'ambientazione come 'Vice City, USA' e la descrive come il lato più oscuro del posto più soleggiato d'America.

I trailer mostrano quartieri di grattacieli, lungomari, vita notturna, cultura dei social e strade sopraelevate che collegano la terraferma alla spiaggia. La stampa ha associato molte inquadrature a luoghi reali di Miami: per questo Leonida Atlas indica Miami come corrispettivo reale fortemente supportato, ma non ufficiale.

Vice City ospita gran parte del cast di supporto, tra cui Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest e i Real Dimez.

fields.analogue_note: Il paragone con Miami si basa su inquadrature associate a luoghi reali; Rockstar non ha pubblicato un confronto ufficiale.

fr.title: Vice City
fr.summary: Le cœur néon du Leonida et la ville principale du jeu, de retour dans une version moderne. Rockstar la présente comme la face la plus sombre de l'endroit le plus ensoleillé d'Amérique.
fr.body:
Vice City revient au centre de Grand Theft Auto VI, réinventée pour l'époque actuelle. Le site officiel de Rockstar présente le décor comme « Vice City, USA » et le décrit comme la face la plus sombre de l'endroit le plus ensoleillé d'Amérique.

Les bandes-annonces montrent des quartiers de tours, des fronts de mer, la vie nocturne, la culture des réseaux sociaux et des chaussées reliant le continent à la plage. La presse a rapproché de nombreux plans de lieux réels de Miami ; Leonida Atlas indique donc Miami comme équivalent réel bien étayé, mais non officiel.

Vice City abrite une grande partie des personnages secondaires, dont Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest et Real Dimez.

fields.analogue_note: La comparaison avec Miami repose sur des plans associés à des lieux réels ; Rockstar n'a publié aucune comparaison officielle.

ru.title: Вайс-Сити
ru.summary: Неоновое сердце Леониды и главный город игры, вернувшийся в современном облике. Rockstar называет его самой тёмной стороной самого солнечного места Америки.
ru.body:
Вайс-Сити возвращается в центр Grand Theft Auto VI в переосмысленном современном виде. Официальный сайт Rockstar представляет место действия как «Vice City, USA» и описывает его как самую тёмную сторону самого солнечного места Америки.

В трейлерах видны плотные кварталы высоток, пляжные набережные, ночная жизнь, культура соцсетей и дамбы, соединяющие материк с пляжем. Пресса сопоставила многие кадры с реальными местами Майами, поэтому Leonida Atlas указывает Майами как хорошо подтверждённый, но не официальный реальный прототип.

В Вайс-Сити живут многие второстепенные персонажи, включая Бубби Айка, Дре'Куана Приста и Real Dimez.

fields.analogue_note: Сравнение с Майами основано на кадрах трейлеров, сопоставленных с реальными местами; официального сравнения Rockstar не публиковала.

sources.rs_vi: Official region name; Jason's and Brian's profiles are set in the Keys.
sources.pcgamesn_map: Describes the archipelago, dive bars and waters.
sources.wiki: Lists Leonida Keys among the main regions.

en.title: Leonida Keys
en.summary: A chain of islands with white sand, dive bars and a long smuggling history. It is where Jason works for Brian Heder.
en.body:
The Leonida Keys are an island chain off the southern tip of the state. Rockstar's character profiles anchor Jason Duval and Brian Heder here, tying the region to the smuggling trade that runs through the story's opening.

Trailer footage and press coverage describe tropical islands, marinas, dive bars and dangerous waters. The region is widely compared to the Florida Keys.

tr.title: Leonida Keys
tr.summary: Beyaz kumları, salaş barları ve uzun bir kaçakçılık geçmişi olan ada zinciri. Jason burada Brian Heder için çalışıyor.
tr.body:
Leonida Keys, eyaletin güney ucunun açıklarında uzanan bir ada zinciri. Rockstar'ın karakter profilleri Jason Duval ve Brian Heder'i burada konumlandırıyor ve bölgeyi hikâyenin başlangıcındaki kaçakçılık işine bağlıyor.

Fragmanlar ve basın; tropik adalar, marinalar, salaş barlar ve tehlikeli sulardan söz ediyor. Bölge sıkça Florida Keys ile karşılaştırılıyor.

es.title: Cayos de Leonida
es.summary: Una cadena de islas de arena blanca, bares de buceo y una larga historia de contrabando. Allí trabaja Jason para Brian Heder.
es.body:
Los Cayos de Leonida son una cadena de islas frente al extremo sur del estado. Los perfiles oficiales sitúan aquí a Jason Duval y Brian Heder, vinculando la región al contrabando que marca el inicio de la historia.

Los tráileres y la prensa describen islas tropicales, puertos deportivos, bares y aguas peligrosas. La región se compara a menudo con los Cayos de Florida.

zh-CN.title: 莱奥尼达群岛
zh-CN.summary: 一串拥有白沙滩、潜水酒吧和悠久走私历史的岛屿。杰森在这里为布莱恩·赫德工作。
zh-CN.body:
莱奥尼达群岛是位于州南端外海的一串岛屿。Rockstar 的角色介绍把杰森·杜瓦尔和布莱恩·赫德安排在这里，使该地区与故事开篇的走私生意紧密相连。

预告片和媒体报道描述了热带岛屿、游艇码头、潜水酒吧和危险水域。该地区常被拿来与佛罗里达群岛比较。

it.title: Leonida Keys
it.summary: Una catena di isole con sabbia bianca, bar di pescatori e una lunga storia di contrabbando. È qui che Jason lavora per Brian Heder.
it.body:
Le Leonida Keys sono una catena di isole al largo della punta meridionale dello Stato. I profili ufficiali collocano qui Jason Duval e Brian Heder, legando la regione al contrabbando che apre la storia.

Trailer e stampa descrivono isole tropicali, porticcioli, bar e acque pericolose. La regione viene spesso paragonata alle Florida Keys.

highlights: Il cantiere navale di Brian Heder

fr.title: Leonida Keys
fr.summary: Un chapelet d'îles au sable blanc, aux bars de plongeurs et au long passé de contrebande. C'est là que Jason travaille pour Brian Heder.
fr.body:
Les Leonida Keys sont un chapelet d'îles au large de la pointe sud de l'État. Les profils officiels y placent Jason Duval et Brian Heder, liant la région à la contrebande qui ouvre l'histoire.

Les bandes-annonces et la presse décrivent des îles tropicales, des marinas, des bars et des eaux dangereuses. La région est souvent comparée aux Florida Keys.

highlights: Le chantier naval de Brian Heder

ru.title: Леонида-Кис
ru.summary: Цепь островов с белым песком, барами для дайверов и долгой историей контрабанды. Здесь Джейсон работает на Брайана Хедера.
ru.body:
Леонида-Кис — цепь островов у южной оконечности штата. Официальные профили помещают сюда Джейсона Дюваля и Брайана Хедера, связывая регион с контрабандой, с которой начинается история.

Трейлеры и пресса описывают тропические острова, марины, бары и опасные воды. Регион часто сравнивают с Флорида-Кис.

sources.yt_t1: Swamp footage featuring wildlife and boats.

en.title: Grassrivers
en.summary: Leonida's untamed wetlands: winding mangrove channels, airboats and alligators, inspired by the Everglades.
en.body:
Grassrivers is Leonida's wetland wilderness. Trailer footage shows swamp channels, boats skimming over shallow water and abundant wildlife, alligators most prominently.

Press coverage and Wikipedia compare the region to Florida's Everglades. Its exact extent and position on the map have not been officially published.

tr.title: Grassrivers
tr.summary: Leonida'nın vahşi sulak alanları: kıvrımlı mangrov kanalları, hava pervaneli tekneler ve timsahlar. Everglades'ten esinlenilmiş.
tr.body:
Grassrivers, Leonida'nın sulak vahşi doğası. Fragmanlarda bataklık kanalları, sığ suyun üzerinde kayan tekneler ve başta timsahlar olmak üzere zengin bir yaban hayatı görülüyor.

Basın ve Wikipedia bölgeyi Florida'daki Everglades ile karşılaştırıyor. Bölgenin haritadaki kesin sınırları ve konumu resmi olarak yayımlanmadı.

es.title: Grassrivers
es.summary: Los humedales salvajes de Leonida: canales de manglar, hidrodeslizadores y caimanes, inspirados en los Everglades.
es.body:
Grassrivers es la naturaleza pantanosa de Leonida. Los tráileres muestran canales de pantano, embarcaciones sobre aguas poco profundas y abundante fauna, con los caimanes como protagonistas.

La prensa y Wikipedia comparan la región con los Everglades de Florida. Su extensión y posición exactas en el mapa no se han publicado oficialmente.

zh-CN.title: 草河
zh-CN.summary: 莱奥尼达未经驯服的湿地：蜿蜒的红树林水道、风扇船和短吻鳄，灵感来自大沼泽地。
zh-CN.body:
草河是莱奥尼达的湿地荒野。预告片展示了沼泽水道、掠过浅水的船只以及丰富的野生动物，其中短吻鳄最为醒目。

媒体报道和维基百科将该地区与佛罗里达大沼泽地相比较。其确切范围和在地图上的位置尚未正式公布。

it.title: Grassrivers
it.summary: Le paludi selvagge della Leonida: canali di mangrovie, idroscivolanti e alligatori, ispirate alle Everglades.
it.body:
Grassrivers è la natura paludosa della Leonida. I trailer mostrano canali, imbarcazioni che sfiorano l'acqua bassa e fauna abbondante, soprattutto alligatori.

Stampa e Wikipedia paragonano la regione alle Everglades della Florida. Estensione e posizione esatte sulla mappa non sono state pubblicate ufficialmente.

fr.title: Grassrivers
fr.summary: Les marais sauvages du Leonida : chenaux de mangrove, hydroglisseurs et alligators, inspirés des Everglades.
fr.body:
Grassrivers est la nature marécageuse du Leonida. Les bandes-annonces montrent des chenaux, des bateaux filant sur des eaux peu profondes et une faune abondante, alligators en tête.

La presse et Wikipédia comparent la région aux Everglades de Floride. Son étendue et sa position exactes sur la carte n'ont pas été publiées officiellement.

ru.title: Грассриверс
ru.summary: Дикие болота Леониды: извилистые мангровые протоки, аэроглиссеры и аллигаторы. Вдохновлено Эверглейдс.
ru.body:
Грассриверс — болотистая глушь Леониды. В трейлерах видны протоки, лодки над мелководьем и богатая фауна, прежде всего аллигаторы.

Пресса и Википедия сравнивают регион с Эверглейдс во Флориде. Точные границы и положение на карте официально не опубликованы.

attributes.real_world_analogue: Florida's faded Gulf/Panhandle coastal towns (community comparison)

sources.pcgamesn_map: Describes a forgotten coastal town with empty strip malls.

en.title: Port Gellhorn
en.summary: A former vacation town on Leonida's forgotten coast, now known for shuttered attractions, rough motels and an underground economy.
en.body:
Port Gellhorn is presented as a coastal town past its prime: once a holiday destination, now defined by closed attractions, cheap motels and an economy that has moved underground.

Community analysts compare it to faded Gulf Coast resort towns, and one outlet likens its mood to Atlantic City. Neither comparison is official, and Rockstar has not shown where the town sits on the map.

sources.pcgamesn_map: Describes smoking factories and a biker gang.

en.title: Ambrosia
en.summary: An inland industrial town dominated by its refinery and associated in coverage with a notorious biker gang.
en.body:
Ambrosia is an inland region built around heavy industry. Coverage describes smokestacks dominating the skyline and a local biker presence.

Rockstar has named the region officially, but details about its gangs, businesses and exact location remain thin before release.

sources.rs_vi: Official region name: Mount Kalaga National Park.
sources.pcgamesn_map: Mentions fishing, hunting and off-road trails.

en.title: Mount Kalaga National Park
en.summary: Leonida's protected backcountry of forests, trails and waterways, popular with hunters, anglers and off-roaders.
en.body:
Mount Kalaga National Park is Leonida's rugged wilderness. Coverage of official material points to hunting, fishing and off-road trails.

Guides commonly describe it as part of the northern wilderness. Leonida Atlas treats that placement as approximate until an official map is published.

sources.rs_vi: Named in Lucia Caminos's official profile.
sources.yt_t1: Trailer 1 opens inside a corrections facility.

en.title: Leonida Penitentiary
en.summary: The state prison where Lucia Caminos served time. It is the first location players see in Trailer 1.
en.body:
Leonida Penitentiary is named in Lucia's official profile as the place her fight for her family landed her. Trailer 1 opens with Lucia in custody talking to a corrections officer.

Its position on the map is unknown, so Leonida Atlas does not place a marker for it.

sources.pcgamesn_map: Refers to 'Vice Beach' connected to Vice City by causeway.

en.title: Vice Beach
en.summary: The beachfront district across the causeways from mainland Vice City, home to its oceanfront nightlife strip.
en.body:
Trailers repeatedly show a beachfront strip of hotels, bars and crowds across the water from downtown Vice City. Coverage refers to the area as Vice Beach, comparing it to Miami Beach and Ocean Drive.

The name is reported by press coverage; Leonida Atlas will upgrade the verification once an official source uses it.

sources.wiki: Lists Stockyard as a location based on Miami's Wynwood neighbourhood.

en.title: Stockyard
en.summary: A Vice City neighbourhood reported to be modelled on Miami's mural-covered Wynwood arts district.
en.body:
Wikipedia lists Stockyard among GTA VI's locations and compares it to Wynwood, Miami's street-art district.

Leonida Atlas records this as reported. Its exact position within Vice City has not been officially shown.

sources.rs_vi: Brian Heder's official profile mentions his boat yard in the Keys.

en.title: Brian Heder's Boat Yard
en.summary: The Keys boat yard from which Brian Heder still runs his smuggling business.
en.body:
Brian Heder's official profile says he still moves product through his boat yard in the Keys. That makes it one of the story's starting points for Jason Duval.

The yard exists according to official material, but its exact location has not been shown. The map marker sits at the Leonida Keys regional level only.
